saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Ιουνίου — «Όσιος Έρασμος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It is plainly the same entry the folder's Romanian row keeps on 18 June: the page says only that the venerable Erasmus reposed in peace, and gives no country and no year. Its note that the name belonged to a distinguished Dutch writer and grammarian is one of saint.gr's general remarks on the name and not a statement about this saint. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
